name: Create Water Cycle Science Lesson Flipchart
description:
A 5th grade science teacher needs a flipchart lesson on the water cycle. Create a 3-page flipchart:

Page 1 — Introduction: Title 'The Water Cycle' with subtitle text naming the three main stages: Evaporation, Condensation, and Precipitation.

Page 2 — Visual diagram: Draw at least 3 shapes on the canvas to represent the three stages of the water cycle (e.g., a shape for the water body/evaporation stage, a shape for the cloud/condensation stage, and a shape for rain/precipitation). Add a text label near each shape identifying which stage it represents.

Page 3 — Quick assessment: Title 'Quick Check' with at least two written questions for students to answer about the water cycle.

Login as ga / password123. Save the completed flipchart as /home/ga/Documents/Flipcharts/water_cycle_lesson.flipchart
